chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hannan ibn Sudeyr, who said:

Al-A'la ibn Kamil asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and I was present, about the catfish (or eel). So he (peace be upon him) said: 'We found in the Book of Ali (peace be upon him) certain things forbidden from the fish, so do not go near them.' Then Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'That which does not have a skin/scales from the fish, do not go near it.'

key_terms.الْجِرِّيِّ: Catfish or eel, a specific type of fish often discussed in fiqh regarding scales
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The Book of Ali (peace be upon him), referring to a specific hadith collection or tradition attributed to him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating fish without scales in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the general Shia juristic principle that fish are permissible only if they possess scales (qishr), a criterion derived from the Book of Ali (AS) and clarified by Imam al-Sadiq (AS). The specific mention of 'al-jurri' (often identified as catfish) highlights the historical context of distinguishing between locally known aquatic species and the broader category of scaleless fish, reinforcing the exclusion of those without scales from consumption.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hannan Bin Sudeyr who said,

‘Al-Aa’la Bin Kamil asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and I was present, about the catfish. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> found in the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, Forbidden things from the fish, therefore do not go near these’. Then Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What does not happen to have scales for it, from the fishes, so do not go near it’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hanan ibn Sadir who has said the following:

“Al-‘Ala’ ibn Kamil asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when I was present, about eel. He (the Imam) said, ‘We have found in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, of fish certain varities are unlawful for food so do not go close to them.’ Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then said, ‘Of fish those which have no scales, do not go close to them.’”
